name: plainlang
description: Syntax highlighting and live diagnostics for PlainLang, the English-like beginner language.

plainlang.pythonPath.description: Command used to run the Python interpreter (must be able to run plainlsp.py).

plainlang.serverPath.description: Path to plainlsp.py. Leave empty to use the copy bundled with this extension.

scripts.postinstall: echo Run 'vsce package' to build a .vsix, then 'code --install-extension plainlang-0.1.0.vsix' to install it.
